name: Absolute Medical Equipment Sales
old_description: Our commitment to excellence goes far beyond the initial sale. We will be there for you in the long run. We sell and can source a very wide array of equipment and strive to be your single source for reliable and cost efficient medical equipment.
about:
Absolute Medical Equipment Sales, based in New York, New York, has been a supplier of refurbished medical equipment since 2001. The company operates as Absolute Medical Services, Inc., and maintains a small-business approach despite serving an international customer base.

The company specializes in the refurbishment and resale of pre-owned medical devices, including ultrasound machines and probes, defibrillators, patient monitors, infusion pumps, bone densitometers, and EKG machines. Each unit undergoes a refurbishing process certified to original equipment manufacturer standards. Absolute Medical also operates a biomedical and service division staffed by certified sonographers and nurses, offering replacement, loaner, and rental equipment with same-day delivery for customers in the New York metropolitan area.

Its customers range from large hospital systems and university medical centers to specialized clinics, surgery centers, and private practices. The company has supplied equipment to institutions such as Montefiore Medical Center, vein centers, cardiac care and vascular medicine practices, and international buyers in Australia and New Zealand. Typical buyers include radiology departments, emergency medicine teams, and obstetrics units seeking cost-effective alternatives to new equipment.

Absolute Medical differentiates itself through a commitment that extends beyond the initial sale, positioning itself as a single source for reliable, cost-efficient equipment. The company emphasizes a personalized, small-business service model, backed by a 7-day unconditional money-back guarantee and a team of expert equipment representatives who assist with product selection and clinical application support.

name: Absolute Packaging
old_description: We as Absolute Packaging design and manufacture protective foam interiors specifically configured for a wide assortment of products, using a variety of cushioning materials. Our professional design engineers create
about:
Absolute Packaging was established in 2001 in Springfield, Virginia, by packaging professionals focused on delivering responsible packaging development and product-specific packaging to the DC metropolitan area. The company describes itself as the only custom packaging solutions provider in Northern Virginia.

The company designs and manufactures protective foam interiors configured for a wide assortment of products using a variety of cushioning materials. Its services include custom foam design and fabrication, custom box design, in-stock packaging, wood crating and pallets, and design and engineering. Professional design engineers create packaging "from the inside out" using advanced manufacturing equipment and proprietary systems to produce consistent, predictable products. Designs are engineered to meet International Safe Transit Association (ISTA) drop testing specifications, including ISTA 1-A.

Absolute Packaging serves the US Military, federal government agencies, bio-tech firms, electronics manufacturers, educational institutions, transportation companies, wholesalers, manufacturers, distributors, and art galleries and museums. Notable clients include The National Archives. The company has served the DC metropolitan area for over a decade.

The company emphasizes core values of honesty, professionalism, and respect, and offers a proprietary Customer Stock Program that eliminates storage and material delay issues for qualified businesses. Its design engineers have over 31 combined years of experience in art and museum packaging.

name: Accutron
old_description: electronic printed circuit board assembly. Our reputation is founded upon over 35 years
about:
Accutron, based in Windsor, Connecticut, was established in 1989 as a contract manufacturer specializing in printed circuit board assembly. In September 2024, the company became part of Foxtronics EMS, a move intended to broaden its capabilities and increase its visibility in the electronics industry.

The company operates a 55,000-square-foot facility with a staff of 130-plus, offering full-service contract manufacturing that spans SMT and through-hole PCB assembly, box-build integration, engineering support for design for manufacturability and testability, and a dedicated quick-turn prototype line. Testing services include flying-probe, in-circuit, functional, and burn-in validation, while material management and supply-chain programs round out the offering.

Accutron serves the medical, aerospace, and telecommunications sectors, holding ISO 13485 for medical devices, AS 9100 for aerospace, and ITAR registration for defense-related work. Customers range from OEMs needing prototype runs to those requiring full-scale production and system-level integration.

The firm emphasizes a proactive management approach and a reputation built on simplifying complex technologies, competitive pricing, and swift time-to-market delivery, with traceability down to the component lot level through its Aegis manufacturing execution system.

about:
Accutronics, LLC was founded in 1984 in Chelmsford, Massachusetts. The company operates as a privately held electronics contract manufacturer; no founders are named in public materials.

The firm provides full-service electronics manufacturing, including printed circuit board assembly (surface-mount and through-hole), box-build and system integration, cable and wire harness assembly, quick-turn prototype builds, and a range of test services such as solder-paste inspection, automated optical inspection, flying-probe and functional test. It also offers selective and wave soldering, washing, and ionic contamination testing. The company describes its focus as high-mix, low-to-medium volume production, with dedicated new-product-introduction lines for rapid prototyping.

Accutronics serves original equipment manufacturers in medical devices, semiconductor equipment, industrial automation, robotics, internet-of-things, consumer electronics, and military/defense sectors. It highlights ISO 13485:2016 certification for medical-grade work and ITAR registration for defense programs.

The company emphasizes a vertically integrated model that eliminates third-party handoffs, dedicated program managers for consistent communication, an on-time delivery guarantee, and continuous investment in equipment and technology to maintain flexibility and precision.

name: Actuated Medical, Inc.
old_description: Millions of patients with Parkinson’s disease, Alzheimer’s disease, brain cancer, epilepsy, and other neurological disorders depend on therapies that must reach precise locations within the brain to be effective. NeuralGlider® is a validated precision brain access platform designed to improve target accuracy and support more effective delivery of brain-directed therapies.
about:
Actuated Medical, Inc. operates from Bellefonte, Pennsylvania. The clinical-stage medical device company develops technologies aimed at improving the delivery of therapies to precise locations within the brain.

Its flagship platform, NeuralGlider®, uses electronically controlled ultrasonic motion to maintain a desired trajectory during insertion through delicate brain tissue. Preclinical studies have shown the system can deliver gene therapies to deep brain targets using smaller-diameter cannulas, resulting in healthier cells at the insertion site and reduced drug reflux. The company focuses on refining this platform for multiple brain-directed therapy categories.

The technology addresses conditions such as Parkinson’s disease, Alzheimer’s disease, brain cancer, epilepsy, and other neurological disorders where accurate delivery is critical. Potential customers include neurosurgeons, medical device manufacturers, and research institutions developing deep-brain therapeutics.

Actuated Medical was founded to solve what it calls the bottleneck in brain therapeutics: not biology alone, but delivery. The NeuralGlider® platform is designed to improve target accuracy, reduce tissue trauma, and enable smaller cannulas, which the company says can lead to more effective treatment outcomes.

about:
ADJ Sheet Metal was founded in 2002 in White Plains, Maryland, about 30 miles south of Washington, DC. The company began as a custom sheet metal fabrication and installation business serving the Maryland, Virginia, and DC metropolitan areas, including Baltimore and Richmond.

A workforce of more than 250 industry veterans runs highly automated equipment including CNC tables, lasers, water jets, a CNC plasma table, press brakes, shears, and machining tools. Core processes cover cutting (laser, water jet, plasma, shear), forming (press brake, rolling, stamping, punching, folding), and joining (welding, brazing, spot welding, riveting), along with machining and stretching. The company also provides estimating, BIM coordination using Trimble, design‑assist, and UL‑listed electrical box fabrication.

ADJ serves commercial construction contractors, federal government agencies, and mechanical and electrical trades across the Mid‑Atlantic. Typical projects include commercial special projects, design‑assist and tenant renovations, new construction, and federal building work in Maryland and the District of Columbia. The shop produces rectangular and spiral lock‑seam air ducts, custom HVAC cabinets, sheet metal fittings, and electrical enclosures for clients ranging from general contractors to federal facility managers.

The company states its mission is to provide a safe, productive workplace with the ultimate goal of delivering quality sheet metal products and installation while striving for industry leadership built on customer service, reliability, technology, innovation, and integrity.

The portfolio includes over 500 Class I and II medical devices organized into five divisions, 500-plus pharmaceuticals in 13 dosage forms, 150-plus supplements, and 250-plus veterinary items.
